summary: Verified all 5 features for ClauseGuard iteration 12. All features are working correctly: 1) Dashboard has 'Sync All Clauses' button in quick actions grid, 2) POST /api/clauses/sync-full-text endpoint fetches full clause text from acquisition.gov, 3) POST /api/export/batch with include_full_text=true returns full clause text (>50,000 chars), 4) Batch export fetches from acquisition.gov if text is short (<1000 chars), 5) Agiloft create_clause method has detailed logging for debugging upload issues.

features_verified_this_iteration.verification: Button visible in quick actions grid (7th button). Clicking triggers sync-from-acquisition-gov and sync-full-text endpoints. Toast shows 'Synced 872 new clauses from index'.
Endpoint requires auth (401 without). With auth, returns success=true, synced count, failed count. Successfully synced 3 clauses in test.
Returns full clause text (50,000 chars for 52.212-4). Text starts with actual clause content, not just summary. Works for PDF, JSON, and CSV formats.

features_verified_this_iteration.feature: Batch export fetches from acquisition.gov if text is short
features_verified_this_iteration.verification: Code checks if text < 1000 chars or starts with summary patterns. If so, fetches from acquisition.gov and caches result. Verified in backend logs.
create_clause method logs: clause_number, payload, response status, response text (first 500 chars). This will help debug 'Uploaded 0 of 1' issue.

passed_tests: batch export JSON with full text returns >1000 chars
batch export fetches from acquisition.gov for short text
batch export PDF format returns valid PDF
batch export CSV format returns valid CSV
Dashboard 'Sync All Clauses' button triggers sync
critical_code_review_comments: Agiloft upload showing 'Uploaded 0 of 1' is likely an Agiloft API permission/format issue - the create_clause method now logs detailed response info for debugging. User needs to check Agiloft API permissions and field mappings.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 features verified: 1) Dashboard 'Sync All Clauses' button works and syncs clauses from acquisition.gov, 2) sync-full-text endpoint fetches full text for clauses missing it, 3) batch export returns full clause text (50,000 chars), 4) batch export fetches from acquisition.gov if text is short, 5) Agiloft create_clause has detailed logging. The Agiloft 'Uploaded 0 of 1' issue is likely an API permission/format issue on the Agiloft side - the logging will help debug this.

verification_notes.feature_1_sync_button: VERIFIED - Button visible in Dashboard quick actions grid. Clicking shows 'Syncing clauses from acquisition.gov...' toast, then 'Synced 872 new clauses from index' success toast.
verification_notes.feature_2_sync_full_text: VERIFIED - Endpoint at /api/clauses/sync-full-text?limit=N. Requires auth. Returns {success, synced, failed, total_checked}. Successfully synced 3 clauses in test.
verification_notes.feature_3_batch_export_full_text: VERIFIED - Batch export with include_full_text=true returns 50,000 chars for clause 52.212-4. Text is actual clause content from acquisition.gov.
verification_notes.feature_4_fetch_if_short: VERIFIED - Code checks len(text) < 1000 or text.startswith('Full text available') or text.startswith('This clause'). If true, fetches from acquisition.gov.
verification_notes.feature_5_agiloft_logging: VERIFIED - create_clause logs: clause_number, payload, response.status_code, response.text[:500]. This will help debug upload issues.
